deskE1ErrNoMoreRelays: Every server in the link was tried.

@deskE1ErrMessageInvalid.description: Inline error under the payment message field.

deskE1ErrWrongNetwork: This link is for another network.

@deskE1ErrWrongNetwork.description: The payment link belongs to another Epic Cash network.

@deskE1ErrCodeExpired.description: An epic1 or in-person payment code is no longer valid.

deskE1ErrWalletTooNew: Made by a newer version of the app. Update to open this wallet.

@deskE1ErrWalletTooNew.description: The wallet's data was written by a newer app version.

@deskE1SameCodeTwice.description: Two devices answered one in-person payment code; it is not safe to go on with it.

@deskE1RetireAsk.description: Confirm dialog for retiring printed payment code number {n}.

@deskE1Retire.description: Button: retire a printed payment code.

@deskE1Keep.description: Button: keep the printed payment code (cancel retiring).

deskE1ErrCodeWrongNetwork: This code is for another network.

@deskE1ErrCodeWrongNetwork.description: A scanned in-person payment code belongs to another Epic Cash network.

deskE1ErrNotInPerson: Not a code this wallet can pay or check.

@deskE1ErrNotInPerson.description: A scanned animated code is neither an in-person code this wallet can pay nor an answer to one of its own codes (altered, or meant for another device).
